notes: This is a necessary pressure screen for a layerwise P2D baseline with one shared 200-Gbps cut. Compute omits collectives and control overhead, so real inter-wave slack can be larger. It is not a simulated TTFT or proof that concurrent sources share one physical cut. The cache-fraction threshold assumes a Prefill cache hit, a cold Decode prefix, full KV retransmission, and compute linear in fresh tokens; attention on long cached contexts and a cache-aware Decode choice can defeat it.
profile_condition: 2048-token first prefill chunk, no prior KV
